thread:
Avery (CEO): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands: asked to capture why we're winning or losing deals and what feedback repeatedly comes up. I'll kick off with 3 patterns we saw this quarter. TL;DR: wins = latency/cost story + easy onboarding; losses = SSO/compliance gaps, stability at scale, missing connectors. Qs?

Sam (Product): Nice summary. From roadmap POV: prioritized SSO + enterprise audit logs + sticky onboarding flows. We can slide canary for SSO next sprint. Action: will create RFC and a short one-pager for field.

Maya (Sales): From the field: biggest ask is "bring-your-own-key" + SOC2 scope details. Several prospects cited vendor lock-in fears. Also 2 logos wanted dedicated capacity SLA and clearer cost modeling for high-throughput inference.

Priya (CS): On post-sale retention: when we win, it's usually quick POC success with example prompts + Redwood Optimize recommendations. When we lose post-POC, root cause is poor ops docs and unclear runbooks for on-call teams.

Leo (SE): Adding: customers care about inference determinism for evals and model version pinning. Small SE collateral (config snippets) reduces friction. Example we show in demos:
```yaml
model_pin: v1.2
rollout: canary
```

Jon (Eng): For stability losses, top issue was long-tail latency spikes during batch surges. We're deploying better tracing and a KV-cache miss metric this week to help correlate.

Maya (Sales): Any ETA on BYOK? Prospect wanted legal + KMS integration details before committing.

Avery (CEO): BYOK + KMS is in the dedicated/private pipeline. Tentative ETA: Q3 beta. We need a short one-pager for sales now. @Sam can you own a 1-pager?

Sam (Product): Yup, I'll draft and share in #product-resources by EOD tomorrow. Will include security bullets and suggested contract language for sales.

Priya (CS): Also request: add a 'sample onboarding checklist' to docs — ops teams love checklists and it improves time-to-value.

Leo (SE): +1. I'll add a tiny step-by-step to our POC kit and attach a runnable example.

Jon (Eng): For tracing: rolling out `request.trace_id` to logs. If you see spikes, ping #eng-oncall with the trace id and we'll pull flamegraphs.

Avery (CEO): Great. Two asks to leadership: 1) fund a quick docs/SE collateral sprint next month, 2) prioritize publishing SOC2 artifacts + a public FAQ for sales. I'll discuss with finance tomorrow.

Maya (Sales): :thumbsup: This will help shorten cycles.

All-Hands Bot: Reminder: follow-up notes + action items posted -> https://notion.redwood/workspace/all-hands-1773123456

Priya (CS): Small ask — can we get a quantified list of lost deals by reason for Q1? That helped prioritize product work last year.

Sam (Product): I'll pull that report with @Maya and share by Friday.

Avery (CEO): Thanks — love the energy here. If anyone has raw notes or snippets from customer calls, drop them on the Notion page. Closing thread.
